Automated weekly sweep of the Model Atlas.

**Nothing here is merged automatically.** This branch is a proposal: every model field
in this project exists because a person judged it sourced, and that is what makes the
site citable. Review the diff, not just this summary.

The agent was asked to separate, in its own summary below or in the commit message:

- what it **verified against a primary source**, naming the source
- what came only from **secondary reporting or search**
- what it **could not check at all**, and why

and to flag every judgement call — variant naming, mapping a leaderboard row to a
differently-named model, preview versus GA, whether a model belongs here at all.
Those are the parts worth your attention; they do not show up in a diff on their own.

### Reviewing checklist

- [ ] Any new model's blank fields are blank because nobody published them, not
      because the agent did not look
- [ ] No attention mechanism or architecture inherited from a family resemblance
- [ ] `intel` / `coding` come from Artificial Analysis, or are `null`
- [ ] Notes are written fresh, not adapted from a lab's wording
- [ ] `npm run verify` passes, allowing the two expected diagram-hotlink failures
